Issue Description: The active configuration descriptor allocated by libusb_get_active_config_descriptor() is never released, which leaks memory on each successful GetDeviceInfo call.
Suggested Fix: Release config_desc with libusb_free_config_descriptor() after its contents have been consumed.

Source Code Snippet: status = USBDeviceImplementation::instance()->getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor(devs[index], &deviceInfo); if (Core::ERROR_NONE != status) { ... } else { LOGWARN ("getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor Failed"); }
Issue Description: GetDeviceInfo() treats a successful descriptor lookup as a failure, so it skips parent/device-level population and emits a misleading failure log on the success path.
Suggested Fix: Invert the status check so the hierarchy fields are populated only when getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor() returns Core::ERROR_NONE.
